title: NNTP: update Path: header on transit (son-of-1036)
description: 9c0: transit/peering/ingestion.rs (or pipeline.rs) does not prepend local FQDN to Path: header before storing. son-of-1036 §3.3: each transit hop must prepend its FQDN. Fix: in ingest pipeline, parse Path: header value, prepend config.hostname, write back.
